name: Story Animation Polish
description: Per-image reveal animations (fade-in, gentle zoom) for story chapter photos, replacing current static placeholder slots with scroll-triggered Framer Motion effects. Deferred from feat-005 for mobile performance
acceptanceCriteria: Story images animate into view with fade-in and gentle zoom on scroll (whileInView)
Animations are subtle and match wedding aesthetic (no flashy effects)
prefers-reduced-motion fully respected: animations disabled when user prefers reduced motion
Animation density stays performant on mobile (no per-card stagger that causes jank)
StoryImageSlot component no longer has unnecessary 'use client' directive if no client-side logic needed
Animations work with real images (next/image) and placeholder slots alike
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build pass
evidence: Implemented per-image fade-in + gentle zoom animation in StoryImageSlot using Framer Motion whileInView with useReducedMotion() guard. No stagger between images (all animate together when entering viewport). Animation: initial opacity:0 scale:1.03 → whileInView opacity:1 scale:1, duration 0.5s easeOut, viewport once:true amount:0.2. Reduced-motion users see no animation (initial:false, whileInView:undefined). Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.
notes: Originally part of feat-002 scope but deferred during feat-005 performance pass to avoid per-card animation overload on mobile. Re-enable with care: use Intersection Observer thresholds and consider stagger only on larger viewports. Keep animation count bounded per viewport. Decision: no stagger at all — all images in a chapter animate simultaneously for mobile performance. 'use client' directive is now necessary again since Framer Motion hooks are used.
